name: huggingface/pybot
title: Hugging Face's 1,000-agent swarm on ELIZA-2026: agents spent most time waiting on merges and context, only 40-60 of 1,000 calling the model at once
summary: Hugging Face describes scaling a swarm of over 1,000 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash agents on a couple of B200 nodes to build PyBot, finding the bottlenecks in git merges, tests and context re-reading rather than GPUs (about 130 tokens read per token written). Swarm tooling (flock, msgboard) is promised in the coming days.

appearances.summary: Hugging Face published PyBot, a chatbot made of about 600,000 lines of ordinary Python rules and no neural weights. A swarm of 1,000 DeepSeek Flash agents wrote it in a week, and it matches SmolLM at 360M parameters.
